## Project Overview
This project extracts store database entries using SQL and transforms them using Python to predict customer churn.

## 1. Data Extraction (SQL)
```{sql}
--| connection: your_database_connection
--| eval: false
SELECT customer_id, order_total, join_date 
FROM customer_sales 
WHERE join_date >= '2025-01-01';
```

## 2. Data Processing (Python)
```{python}
import pandas as pd

# Load and look at data structure
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'customer_id': [101, 102, 103],
    'order_total': [150.50, 23.00, 542.10]
})
print(df.describe())
```
